add: Adds an emoji or sticker to the server.
add emoji: Steal an emoji into this server.
add emoji --emoji: The custom emoji or an image URL.
add emoji --name: The name for the new emoji.
add sticker: Add a sticker to this server.
add sticker --tags: The related emoji, used as the sticker's tag.
afk: Tells anybody who mentions you that you are away, until you next speak.
afk --note: What to tell people, like back at six.
announce: Posts an announcement embed in a channel.
anti-link: Deletes links posted by members without the bypass permission.
appeals: Lets banned members appeal on the dashboard, and picks where staff see the appeals.
ask: Answers questions about the bot, its dashboard, and setting it up.
ask --question: What you want to know. Pick a suggestion or type your own.
audit-logging: Chooses which server events get logged, and where.
auto-responder: Words the bot answers with a reply you write.
auto-role: Gives roles automatically to new members.
automod flagged-words: Block profanity, sexual content and slurs.
automod mention-spam: Block messages that mention too many people.
automod mention-spam --limit: How many mentions to allow in one message.
automod keyword --word: The word or phrase to block.
automod list: List the AutoMod rules in this server.
automod delete: Delete an AutoMod rule by id.
avatar: Shows a user's avatar and banner.
avatar --user: The user to look up. Defaults to you.
balance: Shows a wallet and bank balance.
balance --user: Whose balance to check. Defaults to you.
ban: Bans a user from the server.
ban --delete-days: Days of their messages to delete (0-7).
birthday: Shares your birthday with this server, or sets up birthday posts.
birthday set: Shares your birthday with this server: the day and month, never the year.
birthday remove: Takes your birthday back from this server.
birthday list: Shows the birthdays coming up in this server.
birthday settings: Turns birthday posts on or off, and chooses where they go.
bot uptime: How long the bot has been running.
bot-notifications: Shows what the bot's owners want everybody to know, such as a feature being down.
bot-stats-channel: Posts a self-updating bot statistics message in a channel.
bot-stats-channel set: Choose the channel for the statistics message.
bug-report: Reports a bug to the developers.
case: Looks up moderation cases, and chooses where they are logged.
case view: Shows one case by its number.
case list: Shows the latest cases, or one member's.
case log: Chooses where new cases are posted. Leave the channel out to stop posting them.
casino: Roulette, blackjack, slots and more, played with your wallet.
casino roulette: Opens a roulette table. Public by default, so anybody in the channel can join.
casino roulette --table: Public lets anybody in the channel bet; private keeps the table to you.
casino blackjack: Plays a hand of blackjack against the dealer.
casino blackjack --amount: How much to bet: a number, `half` or `all`.
casino slots --amount: How much to bet: a number, `half` or `all`.
casino hilo: Calls each next card higher or lower, and cashes out whenever you like.
casino hilo --amount: How much to bet: a number, `half` or `all`.
casino coinflip --amount: How much to bet: a number, `half` or `all`.
casino dice: Rolls two dice: bet under 7, over 7, or exactly 7.
casino dice --amount: How much to bet: a number, `half` or `all`.
casino info: Shows every game, what it pays, and this server's bet limits.
casino stats: Shows what this server has gambled, won and lost, for the whole casino or one game.
casino stats --game: One game's stats instead of the whole casino.
casino settings: Opens or closes the casino, switches games on and off, and sets the bet limits.
clear: Bulk deletes recent messages in this channel.
clear --user: Only delete messages from this user.
counting: Runs the counting game in a channel.
create embed: Build and post a custom embed.
create thread: Open a thread in this channel.
create thread --private: Create a private thread instead of a public one.
delete-my-data: Deletes everything the bot keeps about you, in every server. It can't be undone.
deposit: Moves money from your wallet into the bank.
deposit --amount: An amount, or `all`. Leave blank to pick from buttons.
economy create: Open an economy account in this server.
economy delete: Close your account and erase your balance.
economy settings: Sets this server's pay, starting money, robbing and XP rate.
economy shop-role: Puts a role on sale in the shop, changes its price, or takes it off with a price of 0.
economy shop-role --price: What it costs. 0 takes it off sale.
economy status: Check whether you have an account.
fun fake-tweet: Renders a fake tweet from a user.
fun hack: Pretends to hack the mentioned user. It is entirely fake.
fun iq --user: Whose IQ to measure. Defaults to you.
fun nitro: Generates a fake Nitro gift link.
fun master-oogway: Shares a piece of Oogway's wisdom.
fun pepe-sign: Puts your text on a hand-held sign.
fun relationship: Checks the compatibility between two people.
fun relationship --second: The second person. Defaults to you.
game fast-type: Race to type a sentence correctly.
game guess-the-number: Guess the number the bot is thinking of.
game guess-the-pokemon: Guess the Pokémon from its artwork.
give: Grants currency or XP to a member.
give currency: Add money to a member's balance.
giveaway start --duration: How long it runs, for example 1h or 3d.
giveaway start --channel: Where to post it. Defaults to this channel.
giveaway reroll: Pick new winners for a finished giveaway.
heist: Starts a group heist that other members can join.
heist --stake: How much each member puts in (min 200).
help: Everything the bot can do, category by category.
how: Calculates how much of something you are. Results are definitely accurate.
how simp: Shows how much of a simp someone is.
idea: Posts an idea for this server, for members to vote on.
idea submit: Posts your idea to this server's idea board.
idea submit --idea: What you would like to see.
idea settings: Turns the idea board on or off, and picks where ideas are posted.
impersonate: Sends a message through a webhook that looks like another member.
inventory: Shows what you own, and uses it.
inventory --user: Whose inventory to view. Defaults to you.
invites: Shows whose invites brought members in, and turns invite tracking on.
invites view: Shows how many members somebody's invites brought in, and whose invite they joined with.
invites view --user: Whose invites to show. Defaults to you.
invites top: Shows the members whose invites brought in the most people who stayed.
invites settings: Turns invite tracking on or off, and picks where joins are announced.
kick: Kicks a member from the server.
leaderboard: Shows the top ten, by money or by level.
leaderboard economy: The ten richest people, in this server or across every server.
leaderboard economy --scope: Where to start: this server, or everybody's money across every server.
leaderboard economy --sort: What to start ranked by: wallet and bank together, or one of them.
leaderboard levels: The ten highest levels in this server.
levelling setup: Open the levelling panel and switch it on.
levelling boosts: Choose which roles earn bonus XP.
levelling rewards: Choose which roles are handed out at which level.
levelling ignored: Choose channels and roles that earn no XP.
levelling reset: Remove the levelling configuration. Earned XP is kept.
lock: Stops everyone from sending messages in a channel.
lock --channel: The channel to lock. Defaults to this one.
lock --reason: Why the channel is being locked.
lookup advice: Gets a piece of random advice.
lookup animal-fact: Shares a fact and a photo of an animal.
lookup meme: Fetches a random meme from Reddit.
lookup minecraft: Checks the status of a Minecraft server.
lottery: Runs and enters the server lottery.
lottery setup --base-pool: Prize money seeded into every round.
member-count: Charts the member breakdown for this server.
modmail: Lets members write privately to the server's staff, in threads only staff can see.
modmail open: Writes to this server's staff. Their replies come to you in a direct message.
modmail close: Closes the mod mail conversation in this thread.
modmail settings: Picks where mod mail threads go, who is pinged and how replies are signed.
music queue: Shows what is playing and what is next.
music nowplaying: Shows the track that is playing.
music stop: Stops playing and clears the queue.
music loop: Repeats the track, the queue, or nothing.
music shuffle: Shuffles what has not played yet.
music remove: Removes one track from the queue.
music clear: Clears everything after the current track.
music volume: Sets how loud the player is.
music volume --percent: 0 to 200. 100 is the track's own level; the player starts at 50.
music system: Turns the music system on or off, and picks who may use it.
music system --action: Leave it out to open the settings panel.
music leave: Stops and leaves the voice channel.
music status: Shows where music comes from, and which players the host has installed.
mute --reason: Why they are being timed out.
nickname: Changes or clears a member's nickname.
nickname --nickname: The new nickname. Leave empty to clear it.
permissions: Lists the permissions a member has in this server.
permissions --user: The member to inspect. Defaults to you.
pet: Looks after your pet. Adopt one from the shop.
pet rename: Give your pet a name of your own.
pet rehome: Rehome your pet for half of what you paid.
pet walk: Take your pet out and cheer it up.
play: Plays a track, or adds it to the queue.
play --query: A link to play, or something to search for.
play --next: Put it straight after the current track.
poll: Posts a poll people vote on.
poll --answers: 2 to 10 answers, separated by |, like Yes | No.
poll --hours: How long it stays open, in hours. 24 unless you say.
poll --multiple: Let people pick more than one answer.
prefix: Shows and changes the prefix for text commands.
profile: Views and edits your public profile.
raid-protection: Holds back brand new accounts and alerts staff when joins spike.
rank: Shows your level and rank in this server.
rank --user: Whose rank to check. Defaults to you.
remind me: Sets a reminder, like /remind me in:2h about:check the oven.
remind me --in: How long from now, like 10m, 2h or 3d.
remind list: Shows your reminders, and cancels any of them.
reset server: Wipe every economy account in this server.
reset levels: Wipe every level in this server.
rob: Tries to rob another member's wallet.
role: Adds or removes a role from a member.
role add: Gives a role to a member.
role remove: Takes a role away from a member.
role-menu: Posts menus members pick their own roles from.
say: Sends a message through the bot.
say --channel: Where to say it. Defaults to this channel.
schedule: Posts a message later, once or every day or week.
schedule add: Schedules a message, like /schedule add channel:#news in:2h repeat:once message:Hello.
schedule add --in: How long from now, like 30m, 2h or 3d.
schedule add --repeat: Once, or every day or week from then.
schedule add --message: What to post. Nobody it mentions is pinged.
schedule list: Shows the scheduled messages, and changes or deletes them.
shop: Browses and buys from the shop.
shop --section: Jump straight to a part of the shop.
slowmode: Sets the slowmode for a channel.
slowmode --duration: For example 10s, 5m or 0 to turn it off.
slowmode --channel: The channel to change. Defaults to this one.
softban: Temporarily bans a user, lifting the ban automatically.
softban add: Softban a user for a set duration.
softban remove --user-id: The ID of the softbanned user.
softban list: List the active softbans in this server.
starboard: Sets up the starboard, where messages with enough ⭐ are reposted.
sticky-message: Keeps a message pinned to the bottom of a channel.
sticky-message setup: Set the sticky message for a channel.
sticky-message setup --channel: The channel to stick the message in.
sticky-message setup --cap: How many messages before it reposts (1-50).
sticky-message disable: Remove the sticky message from a channel.
suggest: Sends a suggestion to the developers.
temp-voice: Sets up join-to-create voice channels, deleted once they empty.
ticket: Sets up the ticket panel members use to contact your staff.
ticket setup: Posts the ticket panel and saves where tickets should go.
ticket setup --category: The category new tickets are created in.
ticket setup --staff-role: The role that can see and handle tickets.
ticket setup --message: The text shown on the panel.
ticket status: Shows how tickets are currently configured.
ticket disable: Turns the ticket system off. Existing ticket channels are left alone.
transfer: Sends money from your wallet to someone else.
treasure: Configures random money drops in chat.
unban --user-id: The ID of the banned user.
unlock: Lets everyone send messages in a channel again.
unlock --channel: The channel to unlock. Defaults to this one.
unlock --reason: Why the channel is being unlocked.
unmute --reason: Why the timeout is being lifted.
user-info --user: The user to look up. Defaults to you.
voice-stats: Shows live member and bot counts in voice channel names.
warn punishments: Choose what each warning does: a timeout, a kick or a ban.
warn info: Show one warning in full, including its edit history.
warn info --warn-id: Start typing to pick a warning.
warn edit: Change the reason on a warning.
warn edit --warn-id: Start typing to pick a warning.
warn remove --warn-id: Start typing to pick a warning.
warn clear: Delete every warning for a member.
welcome: Greets new members when they join, and says goodbye when they leave.
welcome background: Upload a background image for the welcome card.
welcome goodbye: Open the goodbye panel, for a message when somebody leaves.
welcome test: Send yourself the greeting a new member would get.
withdraw: Moves money from the bank into your wallet.
withdraw --amount: An amount, or `all`. Leave blank to pick from buttons.
